rationale: Despite strong relative volume for the day and price holding right at the session high ($17.36), the last five 1-minute candles show extreme illiquidity with zero price range and volume drying up to a few hundred shares per minute. Furthermore, the 5-minute ATR is very tight ($0.0586) and price is already extended nearly two ATRs above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($17.25) during the midday lull. This lack of immediate tape participation makes both a breakout long and a counter-trend short unfavorable on a risk-adjusted basis.
